[.walkthrough]
.Add a view and open it
. In *Edit* mode, click *Views & Routes* in the toolbar. The [.walkthrough-look]#panel# lists each view's class and route.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/01-open.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/01-open.jpg"]
. Click *+*, and type a title in the [.walkthrough-look]#dialog#. Copilot fills in the route and the class name from the title.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/02-add.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/02-add.jpg"]
. Scroll down to choose what the view starts with: [.walkthrough-look]#a template#, such as a dashboard or a form, or an empty view.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/03-type.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/03-type.jpg"]
. Click *Create*. Copilot creates the class and lists the [.walkthrough-look]#new view#. The dialog stays open for another view, so close it when you're done.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/04-create.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/04-create.jpg"]
. Click its route to open it. The new view is a placeholder, ready for components.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/05-go.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/views-and-routes/05-go.jpg"]
